content: The phrase "And now the rest of the story" is famously associated with Paul Harvey, an American radio broadcaster known for his distinctive delivery and storytelling style. Harvey used this catchphrase in his radio program "The Rest of the Story," which aired from 1976 until his death in 2009. The program featured stories that often had a surprising or lesser-known twist, and Harvey would conclude each segment with his signature phrase.
